snippet.title: Carefully Stamped - Wholesome Cozy Postcard Designer Sim - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Craft and sell charming postcards to your customers in a relaxing sandbox full of color and creativity. Carefully Stamped is a cozy job simulator where you are a postcard designer. Take on new orders, craft the cutest mail, write a wholesome note and collect stamps to send your postcards 🎟️✉️

Wishlist on Steam to get notified when the free demo is released!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3771390/Carefully_Stamped/
